commercial_anchors.commercial_summary: Mount Waverley pairs two suburban retail strips - Mount Waverley Village on Stephensons Road beside the station, and Pinewood Shopping Centre in the south-east - with a genuine office and light-industrial employment corridor along its southern edge. That corridor runs along Ferntree Gully Road, Ricketts Road and Forster Road and includes the multi-building Urban Acres business park, converted-warehouse offices and the Melway publishing premises, sitting inside what leasing agents describe as Melbourne's largest employment hub outside the CBD. Health and education premises add further commercial floor space, led by the 98-bed Waverley Private Hospital on Blackburn Road, Mount Waverley Secondary College, Huntingtower School, Avila College and six government primary schools.
